title: Kusanagi Nene — Super Special Practice Session!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then! Let's begin Kuchipatchi's Super Special Practice Session!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whoo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll sing with you and cheer you on!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: You mean it? I feel better already!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's fine and all, but... Isn't “Super Special Practice Session” an awkward name? It's kinda hard to say.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe so, but it reflects Tsukasa's personality rather well, wouldn't you say? And the promise of improvement feels genuine.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, Nene! I've got my serious face on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No problem. I'm looking forward to it too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh, what a dignified expression! Our friend is overflowing with motivation!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh... I guess I can see it...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Everybody's been practicing so hard. I'll be a real bother if I'm still bad tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to honor Kuchipatchi's feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, let's get started. First, the basics!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Put your hands over your belly button... If you have one... Then breathe in slowly through your nose. Try to imagine filling your belly up with air so it sticks out.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi & Miku
rows.Line: *Inhale*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you breathe out, take about twice the time it took to breathe in. While you're doing that, your belly should shrink back down.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi & Miku
rows.Line: *Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: P-Pbbbt... Pbbt... Pbbbbbbt...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh! You've got it, you've got it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just did a lip trill. Once you've got the hang of it, let's try changing your pitch during it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll practice humming next. There's a bit of a trick to this... Tsukasa, can you demonstrate?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Leave it to me! Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hummmm...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: It sounds like he's just saying “hmmm”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, he isn't using his throat, but his nasal cavity... That sound is coming from inside his nose.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Huh?! His nose?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Kuchipatchi, can you put one hand on your neck...area, and one by your nose? You'll be able to feel the vibrations better, which should make it easier to practice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Next up may be our main challenge... We're going to work on your rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The Nenetronome is at the ready. Set the time signature and tempo, and it will sound automatically.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Nenetronome...? Is that a metronome? I didn't realize she had that function.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It's convenient since you can just tell her what to set it to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, let's hear 4/4 at sixty bpm.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to get a grasp of your rhythm sense, so let's start with clapping practice.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Alright! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great job, Kuchipatchi! You practiced so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's see the results of our Super Special Practice Session!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: I-I'm so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't worry. Try to remember the breathing we practiced. Relax, and let your tension melt away.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
*Inhale*
*Exhale*
*Inhale*
*Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Okay, here goes...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You're vocalizing properly, and you've got the rhythm right too!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That means all that's left is...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were sooooo good, Kuchipatchi♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even when Nene joined in partway through, you didn't get distracted and continued to sing well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means you're able to listen out for what those around you are doing! In which case, you should do a fine job singing with your friends as well.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really. Didn't you feel it yourself, Kuchipatchi? Our two voices really melded together into one there.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: You're right, I did...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
As long as you remember that sensation, everything will go great.
And try to keep doing those basic exercises too, if you can.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: You got it, Ms. Nene!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it, Kuchipatchi? You suddenly seem distracted...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: I hear singing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Singing...?

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
Oh! I know this voice! I know the song too!
It's gotta be Mametchi! Mametchi's singing with somebody!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Hey, Mametchi! Where're you at? I'm right here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't hear anything, though...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Huh?! B-But it's totally Mametchi!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your friend must be calling for you, Kuchipatchi!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes... Mametchi likely realized that someone's song brought you here, and had the idea to guide you in the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: H-How do I answer?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You just need to sing back. But...

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We have to say bye bye before you can go there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu & Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We got to be such good friends, and we already have to say goodbye?!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: No way! I wanna keep playing and talking with you gu—

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
...
But, I bet Mametchi's worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're probably right... Mametchi could be out there singing very hard for you and the friends you both treasure, so you can all see each other again.

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line:
...
I'm gonna go see Mametchi!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Thanks so much for doing that super special singing practice session with me, you guys! I'll give that recital all I've got!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good...! I'm sure you'll do great, Kuchipatchi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi's supposed to answer with song, yes? In that case, we'll have to join in to see this through!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
Yeah!
Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kuchipatchi
rows.Line: Y-You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh... There's a light coming from Kuchipatchi...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This really is goodbye.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can tell you're having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to say my goodbye with a smile too.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...! Kuchipatchi...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye bye, Kuchipatchi!!! I had so so sooo much fun singing with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are we never gonna see each other again...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Kuchipatchi comes from someplace far out of reach... Normally, I think that would be the case.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However... I somehow get the feeling that this isn't the end of our story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll meet again?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As short as your time together was, I'd say a real bond was forged today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, if you ask me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems a certainty that your song, your feelings and your bond will bring you all together again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I see. Our chances sound quite high indeed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! Nene, we might get to see Kuchipatchi again!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (When we do, Kuchipatchi, let's sing more together!)
